steps.title: Join the server
steps.description: Add mc.mysterria.net in Multiplayer, accept the resource pack and pick Mysteries in the lobby.

steps.title: Log in
steps.description: Official Minecraft accounts log in on their own. Other accounts register once with /register, then use /login.

steps.title: Link your account
steps.description: Get a code on your website profile and enter it in game. This opens the starter bonus menu.

steps.title: Pick your starter bonus
steps.description: Shortcut makes you a Beyonder now at a lasting cost. Resolve puts a formula in your next chest, at no cost.

steps.title: Find a town or go solo
steps.description: Ask in chat or on Discord for a town that takes new players, or start exploring on your own.

steps.title: Brew your first potion
steps.description: Find a formula, build a Magic Cauldron, gather the ingredients and brew. Drink it to become a Sequence 9 Beyonder.

differences.title: No teleport commands
differences.body: There is no /home, /spawn, /tpa, /rtp or /back. Travel takes time, and some Pathways, such as Door, are how you get around faster. Choose where you settle with care.

differences.title: The open world is safe
differences.body: PvP is off in the wilderness and griefing is against the rules. You only fight other players in zones you enter on purpose, and in towns that turn PvP on.

differences.title: Every generated chest is loot
differences.body: Chests in villages, mineshafts, shipwrecks and other structures hold Beyonder loot and refill over time. Places others have looted are still worth a visit.

differences.title: Progress is slow on purpose
differences.body: The first Sequences take about a week. The highest take months.

differences.title: Seasons end in a reset
differences.body: Each season, called an epoch, ends with a full reset of the world and of every Beyonder's progress. Epoch II began on 16 May 2026, and no end date has been announced.

starterChoices.name: Path of Shortcut
starterChoices.benefit: You become Sequence 9 in the chosen Pathway right away.
starterChoices.cost: Your maximum Spirituality is 10% lower at every Sequence, permanently.
starterChoices.bestFor: Players who want abilities now more than full power later.

starterChoices.benefit: The next generated chest you open is sure to hold a formula.

topics.title: How to join
topics.summary: Where to connect, and how to link your account.
topics.answer: Add mc.mysterria.net to your server list, accept the resource pack and pick Mysteries in the lobby. Java needs version 26.1.2 or newer. Bedrock uses the same address on port 19132.

sections.title: Server details
bullets: Address: mc.mysterria.net, or play.mysterria.net.
Java Edition: version 26.1.2 or newer, on the default port 25565. The server runs 26.2. No mods needed.
Bedrock Edition: the same address, port 19132, on phone or PC. A few custom menus look simpler.
Free to play.

sections.title: Connect
steps: Open Multiplayer, choose Add Server and enter mc.mysterria.net.
Join, and accept the resource pack when Minecraft asks.
In the lobby, open the server selector and pick Mysteries.
Talk to the lobby NPCs before you leave. They explain the basics.
sections.warning: If everything looks like plain Minecraft, the resource pack didn't load. Turn on server resource packs for this server and update your client.

sections.title: Register and log in
paragraphs: Official Minecraft accounts log in automatically and skip this step.
Other accounts register once with /register <password> <password>, then use /login <password> each time they join.
Playing without an official account? Staff recommend SKLauncher. Don't use TLauncher: staff consider it malware.

sections.title: Link your account
steps: Sign in on the Mysterria website and open your profile.
Generate a Minecraft link code.
In game, type /verify and enter the code in the window that opens.
paragraphs: Linking opens the starter bonus menu. It also unlocks the store and gives you a verified prefix in game and a role on Discord.

sections.title: COI Client (optional)
paragraphs: COI Client is our own optional mod for Java, built for Fabric. It gives Minecraft a full Beyonder interface, with ability hotkeys and ritual visuals. Every mechanic still works without it.

topics.title: How the world works
topics.summary: Travel, safety, death and seasons, and how they differ from other survival servers.
topics.answer: Mysterria is one Overworld of 15,000 by 15,000 blocks with no teleport commands. The wilderness is safe, and generated chests refill with Beyonder loot.

sections.title: Map and travel
paragraphs: The Overworld is 15,000 × 15,000 blocks. The Nether and some special dimensions exist, but most Beyonder content is in the Overworld.
sections.warning: There is no /home, /sethome, /spawn, /tpa, /rtp or /back, and none will be added. Some Pathways, such as Door, give you faster ways to travel.

sections.title: Safety and PvP
bullets: PvP is off in the wilderness.
When 50 or more players are online, Cosmos Incursions open PvP zones on the live map. You only fight there if you walk in.
Town owners can turn PvP on for some roles inside their land.
Griefing is against the rules, and town claims protect your land.

sections.title: Death
paragraphs: Death follows vanilla rules: your items drop and there is no keep-inventory. Beyonders also gain a little temporary Madness.
sections.tip: Outside Black Incursion zones, dying never costs you Sequence progress.

sections.title: Seasons
paragraphs: Each season, called an epoch, ends with a full reset of the world and of every Beyonder's progress. Epoch I ended on 8 May 2026, and Epoch II began on 16 May 2026. No end date for Epoch II has been announced.
A reset also clears account links, so you link your account again afterwards.
Since nobody keeps their power past a reset, joining partway through a season is still worth it.

topics.title: Your starter bonus
topics.summary: What your first Pathway choice changes, and the trade-off between Shortcut and Resolve.
topics.answer: The Pathway you pick at the start doesn't make you a Beyonder or lock you in. It only aims one of two starter bonuses.

sections.title: Your Pathway isn't locked
paragraphs: You join a Pathway only when you drink its Sequence 9 potion. If you pick Fool here and later drink a Door potion, you become a Door Beyonder.
You're a Beyonder once the Pathway icon appears in the top-left corner of your inventory.
/magic opens an optional helper that suggests next steps. A Pathway shown there doesn't mean you've joined it.

sections.title: Path of Shortcut
paragraphs: You become Sequence 9 right away, without brewing. In exchange, your maximum Spirituality is 10% lower at every Sequence, permanently.
sections.warning: The penalty never goes away. Advancing or finishing your acting doesn't remove it.

sections.title: Path of Resolve
paragraphs: The next generated chest you open is sure to hold a formula. There is no cost.
sections.tip: Resolve teaches you the normal loop of formula, cauldron, ingredients and brew, and you keep your full power.

sections.title: Confirming
paragraphs: You can't pick again once you confirm. If you made a genuine mistake as a new player, open a ticket on Discord. Staff can sometimes reset it.

topics.title: Brew your first potion
topics.summary: Everything you need to become a Sequence 9 Beyonder.
topics.answer: Find a Sequence 9 formula, build a Magic Cauldron, gather the ingredients and brew. Drink the potion and you're a Beyonder. The first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.

sections.title: What you need
bullets: A complete Sequence 9 formula, or all of its pages. In game it's called a recipe.
A Magic Cauldron, built from an Altar Scroll blueprint.
The formula's main and supplementary ingredients.
Beyonder Chars can replace all of a formula's main ingredients at once.
sections.warning: Sacrificial Altars are for Boons, not potions. Their blueprints look like cauldron blueprints, so check before you build.

sections.title: Brewing
steps: Put the main ingredients, or Beyonder Chars, in the left slots.
Put the supplementary ingredients in the right slots.
Put the formula in the centre slot.
Keep every item in the order the formula shows.
When the brew succeeds, drink the potion.
sections.tip: A failed brew keeps your ingredients. A better cauldron raises your chance of success.

sections.title: Where ingredients come from
bullets: Some are found only in generated chests.
Some drop only from Beyonder Creatures.
Some grow as nodes in the world. Right-click a node to harvest it.

sections.title: Potions expire
paragraphs: A potion lasts two real-time days from the moment it's brewed, so brew when you're ready to drink. An expired potion turns into a Sealed Artifact where it can, but it no longer advances you.

topics.title: Find loot and ingredients
topics.summary: Where formulas and ingredients come from, and how focusing beats bad luck.
topics.answer: Every naturally generated chest is a Beyonder loot chest that refills over time. Open them often, and focus the reward you need most.

sections.title: Loot chests
paragraphs: Chests in villages, mineshafts, dungeons, temples, shipwrecks, buried treasure, bastions and ruined portals all count. There is no special glowing chest.
sections.tip: Chests refill over time, so places you've already looted are worth another visit.

sections.title: Focusing a reward
paragraphs: Pick one reward to focus: potions, formulas, formula pages or Altar Scrolls. Each chest that doesn't give it moves a counter forward, and the chest that fills the counter is sure to give it.
sections.warning: You can't focus ingredients. Find them in chests, take them from creatures, harvest them from nodes or trade for them.

sections.title: Other sources
bullets: Trade with a peaceful Wild Beyonder for goods of a specific Pathway.
Run dungeons. /subspace lists them.
Hunt Beyonder Creatures for ingredients and acting.
Trade spare ingredients to a villager with no profession for Energy Shards.
Check the Brilliant Emporium. Its stock rotates.

topics.title: Advance your Sequence
topics.summary: How you climb after Sequence 9, and where to check your status.
topics.answer: Act out your role until your potion is digested, then brew the next one. Rituals matter more at every step. Your full status is in your inventory.

sections.title: Check your status
steps: Open your inventory.
Click the Pathway icon in the top-left corner.
Hover over your character's head.
sections.tip: This shows your Sequence, acting, Spirituality and Madness. There is no command for it.

sections.title: Acting
paragraphs: Casting spells alone doesn't always count. Each Sequence of each Pathway has its own acting method for you to discover, and the action bar tells you when acting counts. Acting comes from:
bullets: your abilities, used the way your role calls for;
Acting Bottles and bounties (/bounty);
dungeons, for PvE acting;
Cosmos Incursions, for PvP acting;
Mythic Bedwars, Duels and FFA, which carry acting back to your character.
sections.warning: No single source can fill your acting alone. Mix several.

sections.title: Rituals
bullets: Sequence 9 never needs a ritual.
For Sequences 8 to 6, rituals are optional, but skipping one adds Madness that stays for the season.
From Sequence 5 up, the ritual is required.

sections.title: Spirituality and Madness
paragraphs: Spirituality powers your abilities and refills over time. Your maximum grows as you advance.
Madness rises when you die or advance unsafely. Rest and some abilities lower part of it.
sections.warning: Too much Madness and you lose control. Below Sequence 6 that ends your character. From Sequence 6 up you face an Ordeal instead, and how you play it decides how much progress you keep. A third loss of control within 14 days ends the character.

sections.title: Seats and thrones
paragraphs: Anyone can climb to Sequence 4. Above it, each Pathway has a limited number of seats at each Sequence, and when they're full a seat war decides who holds one.
Sequence 0 is one throne per Pathway, held by its god until they stop playing or the season ends.

topics.title: Dungeons, creatures and Incursions
topics.summary: The repeatable activities that give loot and acting.
topics.answer: Use /subspace to find dungeons, hunt Beyonder Creatures as you explore, trade with friendly Wild Beyonders, and check a zone's colour before you enter an Incursion.

sections.title: Dungeons and Rifts
paragraphs: Rifts stand in the open world as pillars of shifting light. Players pour Energy Fragments into a Rift until it opens into a dungeon. Inside, you get one life.
steps: Run /subspace to see every dungeon, its Rift, your power against it and your cooldowns.
Go to the Rift and add Energy Fragments if it still needs weakening.
Form a party with /party and enter.
bullets: Full loot once per dungeon every three days.
Two Help Card runs a day, without the usual loot.
Smaller parties are allowed and get the full reward.

sections.title: Creatures and the Crimson Moon
paragraphs: Beyonder Creatures give XP, acting and ingredients. About once a week a Crimson Moon rises. Fishing under it gives better loot, but it's more dangerous.

sections.title: Wild Beyonders and Guardians
paragraphs: A Wild Beyonder's mood depends on how its Pathway relates to yours. Peaceful ones offer the most targeted trades in the game. Hostile ones are hard fights.
Guardians roam the open world and are meant for groups. Each kill drops a token you spin for rare loot.

sections.title: Cosmos Incursions
paragraphs: When 50 or more players are online, Incursions open PvP zones at random spots on the live map. A zone's colour tells you what dying there costs:
bullets: Green: you drop an item or two, and damage is evened out.
Yellow: you drop more items, and damage is only partly evened out.
Red: you drop everything you carry.
Black: lose to a player and you can lose a Sequence or half your acting.
sections.warning: Walking into a zone means you accept PvP. Logging out won't save you: your body stays behind.

topics.title: Towns, nations and going solo
topics.summary: What a town gives you, and how to play on your own.
topics.answer: Joining a town is the quickest start, and playing solo works too. Towns give you protected land and people for group content.

sections.title: Join a town
paragraphs: Ask in chat or on Discord for a town that takes new players. Members share formulas, ingredients, cauldrons and know-how, and find groups for hard content.
sections.tip: With no teleport commands, a well-placed town and helpful neighbours are a big head start.

sections.title: Play solo
steps: Pick a sensible spot for your base and write down important coordinates.
Open every generated chest, and focus the reward you need most.
Hunt creatures and trade with Wild Beyonders.
Join groups for dungeons or Incursions when you need them.

sections.title: Claims, levels and nations
paragraphs: Towns claim land and give members roles. Higher town levels raise the member limit and unlock passive perks. Towns at Domain level can form nations.

sections.title: Wars
paragraphs: Town wars are opt-in and follow their own rules and commands. Outside them, the wilderness stays safe.

topics.title: Money, Energy Shards and the Emporium
topics.summary: The currencies, and how to turn spare materials into progress.
topics.answer: Your money (Coppets, Licks and Verl d'or) is in /wallet. Spare Beyonder materials become Energy Shards. Emporium points come from voting, login streaks and bug reports.

sections.title: Money
paragraphs: The currencies are Coppets, Licks and Verl d'or, kept in /wallet. Most income comes from item evaluation, which only accepts non-renewable ores mined with Silk Touch.

sections.title: Energy Shards
paragraphs: Trade spare ingredients and formulas to a villager with no profession for Energy Shards. You spend them on Wild Beyonder trades, weakening Rifts, Secret Order upgrades and seasonal events.

sections.title: Brilliant Emporium
paragraphs: The Emporium sells rotating goods, formulas included. It uses its own points, earned by voting, login streaks and accepted bug reports.

commands.purpose: Keep money, evaluate items and pay others

topics.title: Secret Orders, couriers and messages
topics.summary: How to send items and messages, and how to run a private group.
topics.answer: Couriers carry items for you, and Secret Orders are lasting private groups with their own upgrades. For talking, private messages work as usual.

sections.title: Couriers
paragraphs: Courier horns summon couriers that carry items for you. Each type has its own capacity and risks, so check it before you send anything valuable.

sections.title: Secret Orders
paragraphs: Orders are private groups with members, officers, a chat and upgrades. Higher levels unlock ways to travel, such as Instant Summon and a Secret Lair.

commands.purpose: Reply to the last private message

topics.title: Later in the season
topics.summary: Systems that matter once you're established. You don't need them in your first days.
topics.answer: Boons, Sealed Artifacts, churches and the road to Sequence 0 come later. You don't need any of them in your first days.

sections.title: Boons
paragraphs: A Boon is a Sequence an Outer God lends you. It sits beside your Pathway with its own spells and acting, and you raise it by sacrifice at a Sacrificial Altar. You can hold one at a time, and it never climbs past your own Sequence.

sections.title: Sealed Artifacts
paragraphs: Artifacts have strong effects with drawbacks attached. You craft them or find them in loot. An expired potion can also turn into one. Weigh the drawback before you use one.

sections.title: Churches and Honorific Names
paragraphs: At Sequence 4 you can found a church by placing its core in the world. Members' prayer strengthens its perks, and rival churches can go to war.
Your Honorific Name is a five-line invocation that lets other players reach you through a ritual.

sections.title: Uniqueness and Sequence 0
paragraphs: Each Pathway's god sits on one throne at Sequence 0. The road there runs through your Pathway's Uniqueness and ends in a public rite.
A Uniqueness reaches you at 0% accommodation, and dying while you hold it costs some of it.

sections.title: Store and Battle Pass
paragraphs: The store, the premium Battle Pass and subscriptions support the server and add convenience. A free player can still reach every level of power.

topics.title: Troubleshooting
topics.summary: Fixes for the problems new players hit most, from a missing resource pack to account linking.
topics.answer: If the game looks like plain Minecraft, the resource pack didn't load: turn it on and update your client. On Bedrock, a few custom menus look simpler, and that's expected.

sections.title: The server looks like plain Minecraft
steps: Edit the server in your list and set Server Resource Packs to Enabled.
Reconnect and accept the pack.
If it still doesn't load, update your Java client and reconnect.
sections.tip: On Bedrock, a few custom menus look simpler than on Java. That's expected.

sections.title: Account linking didn't work
steps: Go back to your profile and generate a new code.
Type /verify in game and enter the new code.
If signing in to the website failed, clear the site's cookies and try again.
Still not linked? See Help, or open a ticket on Discord.

sections.title: I can't connect
bullets: Check the address: mc.mysterria.net, or play.mysterria.net.
Java: use version 26.1.2 or newer, on port 25565.
Bedrock: use port 19132.
Offline accounts must use /login after they register.

topics.title: Commands
topics.summary: The commands you'll use most, and the ones that don't exist.
topics.answer: Most of your character lives in menus, not commands. Commands mostly open those menus or manage your town and group.

commands.purpose: Log in to an offline account
Link your account with a code from your profile
List dungeons, their Rifts, your power and cooldowns
Create or manage a dungeon party
See today's Tide and what it changes
Keep money, evaluate items and pay others
Manage your town, its roles and claims
Claim or release the chunk you stand in

sections.title: Commands that don't exist
paragraphs: There is no /home, /sethome, /spawn, /tpa, /rtp or /back. Travel is part of the game.
sections.warning: No command shows your Sequence, acting, Spirituality or Madness. Open your inventory, click the Pathway icon in the top-left corner and hover over your character's head.
